title: Building PhilKG: An LLM-Powered Knowledge Graph from the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

contributions.purpose: 从非结构化哲学文本自动建知识图谱
contributions.mechanism: LLM 抽取实体/关系 + 更强 LLM-as-judge 抽样验证的半自动流水线
contributions.evaluation: 作者识别'84% 假阳性下降';但 LLM-judge 打分作者识别仅 0.760、引用抽取仅 0.485
contributions.domain: 数字人文/知识图谱构建
contributions.source_quote: A novel LLM-based knowledge graph construction pipeline with 84% reduction in false positive citations

contributions.purpose: 发布最大规模哲学知识图谱资源
contributions.mechanism: 覆盖 1786 篇 SEP 文章,NetworkX 组装 + 去重
contributions.source_quote: PhilKG, the largest structured representation of philosophical knowledge (144,329 nodes, 116,251 edges)

contributions.purpose: 给出哲学领域文化差异的实证
contributions.mechanism: 美学 vs 伦理学的引用密度/网络结构/时间跨度对比
contributions.source_quote: First large-scale empirical evidence for distinct philosophical field cultures through systematic comparison of aesthetics and ethics

notes: 自声明 4 条(第4条'计算哲学基础'为空泛/期许,略)。大量数据与制作红旗:(1)时间范围 '1000-5024 CE'——引用年份 5024 CE 在未来,数据错误;(2)网络密度 0.93(9972 作者/4600 万边)对共引网荒谬地高,49,966,375 co-citation pairs;(3)最高被引作者全是纯姓氏(Smith 506、Lewis 499、Cohen 387...)——'单名占 69.4%'的消歧失败使'最被引=Smith'成为姓名碰撞伪影,动摇全部发现;(4)Table4 排序错误:'Top Author Lewis(499)'却'Second Author Smith(506)'(第二名引用数更高);(5)引用抽取准确率仅 0.485(低于抛硬币)却称'high technical quality';(6)正文'ancient 0.0%/medieval 0.2%'与 Table5 'Aesthetics ancient 0.2%/medieval 0.8%'不一致。制作红旗:重复章节标题'2 Related Work'紧接'3 Related Work';checklist 模板指令块未删('IMPORTANT, please: Delete this instruction block...'仍在);compute 一栏留 'Justification:[TODO]' 占位。checklist AI 披露:假设 C,实验/分析/写作全 D(GRAIL 将 markdown 无人工编辑扩写为全文)。代码/数据未开放[No]。
